messages:
leah: Quick sync: we need a compact SKU plan for Dedicated listing (trial vs paid). Goal: clear buyer expectations + publisher manifest ready.

omar: Proposal: expose friendly names (Dedicated Starter / Pro / Enterprise). Internally map to SKUs: D-STRT / D-PRO / D-ENT. Trial = D-TRIAL-30.

dina: Legal note: trial must state "no SLA, no guaranteed capacity" and conversion requires explicit opt-in. Will draft short copy.

costas: Ops: for trial we'll disable autoscale and set kms = null. We'll include a tiny terraform snippet in quickstart.

leah: Good. Can we also publish trial caps in manifest (max_tokens_per_minute, max_concurrency)? Keeps abuse down.

omar: Yep. Example manifest fragment I'll add: `{ "sku":"D-TRIAL-30", "dims":["tokens","capacity_hours"], "trial_caps":{"max_tpm":"5000","max_concurrency":"2"} }`

marketplace-bot: Reminder: publisher manifest must include support_url + contact_email + tax_id. See publisher docs.

dina: I'll collect support URL and draft T&Cs by Tue. Omar please push manifest to shared drive when ready.

costas: I'll prepare the quickstart and flag the autoscale comment. ETA Thu.

leah: Perf. Quick 15m follow-up Thu after ops push. Thanks all.
